spells.name: Truesight (Constant)
spells.text: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

spells.name: Haste
spells.text:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the Quickened condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

---

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

Spell Effect: Haste

items.name: Erosion Aura
items.text: 120 feet. The avatar of Yig erodes away the physical integrity of all around it. Creatures and objects in the emanation other than the avatar have their Hardness and resistances reduced by 15. At the start of their turn, a creature in the erosion aura's area takes 6d10 bludgeoning damage with a DC 43 basic Fortitude save save.

items.name: Immunity to Magic
items.text: The avatar is immune to spells of 6th rank or lower and the activations of magic items of 13th level or lower.

items.name: Annihilation Beams
items.text:
A guthallath releases two beams of destruction from its eyes. Each beam is a 120-foot line. Everything in either line takes 13d10 untyped damage with a DC 45 basic Fortitude save save.

A creature reduced to 0 HP is reduced to a fine powder as the Disintegrate spell. There is no additional effect on creatures in any area where the beams overlap.

The guthallath can't use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.
